name: indaiatuba-integra
description: Indaiatuba Integra – protótipo de jornada integrada (MaaS) para a última milha

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
